About this site
Hello, my name is Jaylin. This is my first ever portfolio that will be created on RStudio and will be published onto GIT. I am a psychology major with a statistics minor and I love researching about trauma, PTSD and rehabilitation.

title: Part 1 - Process
text:
Data Source:
Describe the data, including variables and data types:
Identify the research questions:

The NASA APOD dataset contains daily astronomy images and videos from 1995 to the present. It includes date, title, explanation text, image, URL, media type (image/video), and astronomer credits. This is the link: https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/blob/main/data/2026/2026-01-20/readme.md. Research questions: Which months produce the most images of galaxies vs. nebulae vs solar system objects? ; Do explanation lengths correlate with image complexity? ; Has the proportion of videos vs still images increased over time?

title: Part 1 - Process
text:
Data Visualization

What do you want final visualizations to look like?
What do you want to show on your final visualizations in order to answer the research questions? How do you plan to do that?
What is missing from your data or would you need to change in your data to create these visualizations?

title: Part 1 - Process
text:
Data Cleaning

Do you need to reformat any variables into different types (e.g. facotors, time, dates, strings)? Or remove information from variable values?
Do you need to deal with any missing data, especially missing data coded other than NA?
Do you need to filter your data? How?
Do you need to create any new variables? What variables? How?
Do you need to add new data (join) to your data? What data? How?
Do you need to pivot your data in any way? Why? How?
Do you need to summarize any of the variables? Which ones? How?
What other aspects of your data need to be ‘fixed’ in order to make your data visualizations?
Are there any variables you can exclude from your data?

Make your programming more efficient using select(), but need to have three yeses above
